messages:
nav: Noticed CI job printed a Vault transit path + wrapped ciphertext header in logs. not raw secret but treat as potential leak.

priya: paste the line and job id?

nav: redacted: `ERROR: transit unwrap failed: transit/keys/service-backup/key: ciphertext=v1:AbC123...XYZ` from ci-runner-77 build 4221.

tom: ok assume sensitive. immediate steps: 1) snapshot audit logs (KMS/Vault/GCS), 2) strip log line patterns from indexed logs, 3) temporarily remove decrypt permissions from backup SA in staging, 4) rotate transit key and rewrap backups.

infra-bot: Initiating audit snapshot for project-staging (72h) -> job audit-3467001234.

oncall: Ack. exporting to gs://sec-hold/inc-3467001234/audit/ 3. Will DM when complete.

priya: nav can you grep which pods/runners emitted this? `kubectl -n staging logs -l app=backup --since=6h | grep "transit unwrap failed"`

nav: found 2 entries from backup-runner-3 and backup-runner-5. also a partner callback just after. tagging @tom for partner check.

tom: pinged partner eng. will remove encrypt/decrypt role from backup SA in staging now:
`gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding project-staging --member=serviceAccount:backup@project-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor`

priya: also push a quick regex redact in logging pipeline to replace `transit/keys/.+` with `<redacted_kms>` before indexing. small PR incoming.

vault-bot: Received rotate request for transit key: transit/keys/service-backup. Rotation queued. ref=rot-3467.

oncall: Audit export complete -> gs://sec-hold/inc-3467001234/audit-export.tar.gz (attached to INC-2026-0501).

tom: applied RBAC removal in staging (terraform diff: -1 binding).

priya: small PR to redact log path created and linked in INC-2026-0501. CI green, will roll patch to staging in 5m.

vault-bot: Rotation complete. new primary version: 2. Audit log: gs://sec-hold/inc-3467001234/rotation.log

nav: scanned backups bucket, found 6 objects in gs://backups/staging/2026-03-27/ where metadata header matches old ciphertext. owners enumerated in metadata.

tom: owners notified with rewrap instructions and 48h SLA. sample rewrap script in ticket: `python tools/rewrap.py --obj <path> --key transit/keys/service-backup/cryptoKeyVersions/2`

priya: after rewrap window we'll rotate again and then restore least-priv roles. scheduling 30m postmortem tomorrow.

oncall: Incident INC-2026-0501 created (sev3). follow-ups in the ticket.

nav: partner confirms no downloads. closing immediate blast-radius actions: audit snapshot -> RBAC revoke -> rotation -> rewrap plan -> logging redact. follow-ups in INC-2026-0501. :white_check_mark:
